subject: Arte
description_pt: Caracterizar e experimentar brinquedos, brincadeiras, jogos, danças, canções e histórias de diferentes matrizes estéticas e culturais.

components.description_pt: Identificar brinquedos, jogos, danças, músicas e histórias de diferentes tradições culturais
components.description_en: Identify toys, games, dances, songs, and stories from different cultural traditions
components.cc_component_description: Identify cultural elements in fables and folktales from diverse traditions

components.description_pt: Comparar características estéticas de atividades lúdicas em contextos culturais distintos
components.description_en: Compare aesthetic characteristics of play activities across distinct cultural contexts
components.cc_component_description: Compare attributes and characteristics of topics based on facts and definitions

components.description_pt: Relacionar-se respeitosamente com tradições culturais e estéticas diferentes das suas
components.description_en: Engage respectfully with cultural and aesthetic traditions different from one's own
components.cc_component_description: Respond thoughtfully to perspectives that differ from one's own during discussion

components.description_pt: Descrever significados culturais presentes em jogos, danças ou histórias de tradições diversas
components.description_en: Describe cultural meanings embedded in games, dances, or stories from diverse traditions
components.cc_component_description: Identify cultural elements in fables and folktales from diverse traditions

cc_matches.description: Recount stories, including fables and folktales from diverse cultures, and determine their central message, lesson, or moral.

Respond thoughtfully to diverse perspectives, summarize points of agreement and disagreement, and, when warranted, qualify or justify their own views and understanding and make new connections in light of the evidence and reasoning presented.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán interactuar con otros (personas y medios) sobre información para...
* discernir temas principales
* comparar atributos y características según hechos y definiciones
* distinguir detalles clave de temas y/o entidades
* negociar la selección de palabras según el tema o la disciplina
* proponer conclusiones a base de la información de recursos digitales
* analizar la relación entre personas, acontecimientos o ideas en un texto
